name: Swedish Personnummer Luhn Checksum
description: Validates Swedish personal identity numbers (Personnummer) using the Luhn algorithm on the last 10 digits. The date component is the first 6 digits (YYMMDD); samordningsnummer adds 60 to the day. The 10th digit is the Luhn check digit. Supports both YYMMDD-XXXX and YYYYMMDD-XXXX formats — always validates the last 10 extracted digits.
